limitations: The catalog-only browser API returns exact service_unavailable 503 problems for approval counts and instance status. The new journey asserts these responses, corresponding console errors and honest unavailable controls; it permits no other response or console errors.

Frontend validation enforces source department/function identities and relational template/instance integrity, not an independent hardcoded inventory of all 36 role names and purposes. The real API and catalog remain authoritative for those values.
Browser evidence uses pinned Playwright-managed Chromium with desktop/mobile viewport emulation, not physical devices, other engines, screen readers or a production deployment.

The OBJ-02 journey injects only its first malformed hierarchy response. Existing WEB-02 status and WEB-08 operational response fixtures retain their documented scope; this gate does not prove worker execution or external delivery.
The dependency-free restored-base witness must fail by assertion after successful imports, not because frontend dependencies are absent from the isolated Git archive.
CI remains disabled; workflow files and remote branches are unchanged. Verification is local and does not claim whole-system acceptance.
